messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — Acme told @anya they want SSO + org-admin in the pilot. They said if we don’t include both they’ll push the pilot to v1. Need a decision: push timeline, include in MVP, or cut something else.

sam: What’s our estimate for SSO + org-admin? Last numbers I saw were ~3w eng + 1w infra.

leo: That matches my notes. Also need audit events + consent screens for compliance. If we jam everything, QA will flag instability.

anya: They’re our highest-value pilot right now — committed ARR. They said a 2-week slip is tolerable, 6 weeks is not. They prefer we include SSO and basic admin, but I can negotiate.

jin: Design: SSO flows are finished. Org-admin UI is a small user table + role modal. I can pare visuals down to speed dev.

sam: OK tradeoffs:
1) Keep current launch date, cut lower-priority items (~2–3w saved)
2) Add +2 weeks to schedule, keep everything
3) Ship SSO-only for pilot, defer full org-admin + audit to v1

maya: We need crisp acceptance criteria for the pilot MVP. My proposal:
- SSO: SAML + OIDC working end-to-end
- Seat-based roles + ability to invite/remove users
- Minimal admin panel (user list, role toggle)
- Audit events for admin actions (create/delete/role-change) — even if delivered as logs initially
Anything less will create support lift and friction with Acme.

sam: Quick feasibility check: if we apply a cutlist we can free ~2.5 weeks. Still ~3–4d short of full org-admin + audits. Possible but tight.

jin: If we accept a staged UX, I can ship the minimal admin now with a small banner: "advanced controls coming in v1" — lowers dev scope.

leo: We could do a lightweight org-admin (user list + role toggle) now and backlog detailed audit views. But product wants audit events captured server-side. Capturing events is cheaper than building the audit UI.

maya: Suggested cutlist if we keep date:
```
Cutlist -> defer to v1:
- promptstore analytics dashboard
- tenant-level tagging UI
- advanced batching tuning work
- non-critical admin polish (icons, microcopy)
```
This gets us most of the way.

sam: Engineering can accept that cutlist. If we also accept audit events as logs (no UI) we can meet the pilot date. Still expect a 1-week QA buffer.

anya: I’ll ask Acme if they can accept: SSO + basic admin + server-side audit logs, with audit UI in v1 (ETA +3w). I’ll push for the 1-week buffer, not +2.

jin: I’ll prepare the minimal admin screens and patch copy for the "coming in v1" notice.

leo: Action items for eng: prep canary plan, ensure prefixed config so we can rollback quickly if issues during pilot.

maya: Decision path for stakeholders: if Acme accepts server-side logs + audit UI in v1 -> keep timeline and apply cutlist. If they insist on audit UI for pilot -> +2 week slip. @anya please confirm by EOD.

sam: Will update the JIRA epic, tag pilot_acme, and add a hard code-freeze date in 9 days.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch feature/mvp-acme at 2143655000

anya: On it — pinging Acme now, will report back in this thread with their preference. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
